title: A Comprehensive Survey of Direct Preference Optimization: Datasets, Theories, Variants, and Applications
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive survey of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), a core technique for aligning Large Language Models with human values, specifically the 'Helpful, Honest, and Harmless' (HHH) criteria. It evaluates and reviews numerous datasets and applications dedicated to safety alignment, ethical considerations, and harmlessness (e.g., MMSafe-PO, SPA-VL, and VL-RewardBench).
